title: Decisions formed correctly, a taxonomy through practice (2026-10-22)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The problem here is that decisions need to be formed correctly in order to mean something. Decisions need to be recognised for the type of decision they make and then formed appropriately. We should be working to develop a taxonomy through practice.
